name: Klaviyo

tier_1_kpis.name: Net Dollar Retention (NDR / NRR)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: NDR falls below 100% for 2 consecutive quarters (net churn = expansion engine broken)

tier_1_kpis.name: Total customers
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Customer growth decelerates below 10% YoY for 2 consecutive quarters

tier_1_kpis.name: Customers >$50K ARR
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Growth in $50K+ cohort stalls (upmarket motion failing)

tier_1_kpis.name: Revenue / ARR
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Revenue growth decelerates >50% YoY for 2 consecutive quarters

tier_1_kpis.name: Gross margin
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Gross margin compresses below 70% (infrastructure cost discipline lost)

tier_1_kpis.name: Free Cash Flow margin
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: FCF margin turns negative for 2 consecutive quarters (profitability regression)

tier_2_kpis.name: Shopify GMV attach rate or Shopify-sourced % of revenue

tier_3_kpis.name: SMS / CDP attach rate as % of customer base

thesis_breakers_qualitative: NDR falls below 100% — net churn means the expansion flywheel is broken
Shopify platform risk materializes (Shopify launches native email/SMS or changes partner terms)
Gross margin compression below 70% from AI/SMS infrastructure cost
Upmarket motion fails — $50K+ cohort stalls, ARPU growth reverses
Competitive displacement by Braze in mid-market or Attentive in SMS

break_rules.narrative: NDR below 100% for 2 consecutive quarters — net revenue churn means existing customers are contracting faster than they expand, breaking the core SaaS expansion flywheel.
Revenue YoY growth rate decelerates by more than 50% versus prior-year same quarter for 2 consecutive quarters — signals structural demand deceleration, not a one-quarter anomaly.
Gross margin below 70% for 2 consecutive quarters — SMS cost, AI infrastructure, or competitive pricing pressures are eroding the economics of the platform.

business_model_rules.narrative: NDR below 105% for 2 consecutive quarters — deterioration from the ~115-120% range signals expansion-motion slowdown; not a hard break but a watch item.
